h: וַיֵּלֶךְ וְשַׁבָּת תְּשׁוּבָה, ה׳ Vayeilech and Shabbos Shuvah, 5

p: This Shabbos, the first of the year,
is the first Shabbos of Creation:
כִּי בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה נִבְרָא אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן,
for on Rosh Hashanah Adam HaRishon was created,
which is the Shabbos of Bereishis
following the six days of the work
the Shabbos protected him after the sin,
as it is stated in the Midrash
"He said: 'Such is the power of teshuvah!'
Immediately Adam HaRishon stood up and said,
'A psalm, a song for the day of Shabbos.'"
For the essential power of teshuvah
נִתְגַּלָּה לוֹ עַל יְדֵי הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה,
was revealed to him through this Shabbos,
as it is said, "And Elokim saw
and behold, it was very good, etc."
"And He rested on the seventh day
That is, after he felt within himself
what he had corrupted by his deeds —
וְהוּא הָיָה תַּכְלִית מְכוּוָּן שֶׁל הַבְּרִיאָה –
and he was the intended purpose of Creation —
וְעִם כָּל זֶה, עַל יְדֵי קְדוּשַּׁת שַׁבָּת
nevertheless, through the holiness of Shabbos
so that out of everything there should come "very good."
And Hashem Yisbarach, as it were,
הָיָה לוֹ נַיְיחָא וּשְׁבִיתָה מִן הַבְּרִיאָה,
had repose and rest from Creation,
because through the holiness of Shabbos
which is the matter of regret
to the magnitude of the blemish,
as it is stated in the holy Zohar
that the meaning of teshuvah is
or "the Heh returns to the Vav."
And through the bitterness and brokenness of heart:
either the Vav returns to the Heh —
that is, "I am with the crushed one";
or the Heh returns to the Vav —
that is, "with Me is the crushed one."
And this shines forth in a person's heart
and is the aspect of the Shechinta,
from which fear comes into a person's heart,
this is the revelation of the Shechinah."
on the pasuk "And there shall shine for you who fear, etc."
are called "those who fear My Name."
And as they said in the Yerushalmi of Demai
has the awe of Shabbos upon him.
And this is the lower fear.
And there is a further, higher level,
and from it comes the root of teshuvah
for through the shining forth of
the fear of Hashem Yisbarach in his heart,
the magnitude of the blemish becomes known to him,
in that he rebelled against Him, Yisbarach.
"The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Hashem"
for teshuvah is called the fear of Hashem.
עַל פָּסוּק "אַשְׁרֵי אִישׁ יָרֵא אֶת ה׳"
on the pasuk "Fortunate is the man who fears Hashem"
while he is still a man."
And by this reasoning we can understand
why, although it is said after the sin,
and take also from the Tree of Life, etc.,"
he was not banished from Gan Eden
lest he put forth his hand
and take from the Tree of Life
because on Shabbos there shone upon him
and Hashem Yisbarach spoke with him
and he answered, "I heard Your voice in the garden
Let us return to our subject:
on every Shabbos there shines forth
an awakening of teshuvah in a person's heart,
which is the first Shabbos of Creation,
the power of teshuvah shines forth
and therefore it is called Shabbos Teshuvah.
which is within the Ten Days of Teshuvah,
always falls within the seven days,
between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur,
כִּי אֵין שִׁבְעָה יָמִים בְּלֹא שַׁבָּת.
for there are no seven days without a Shabbos.
And through the power of the awakening of teshuvah
that shines forth in the souls of Yisrael
עַל יְדֵי זֶה נִשְׁפָּע הֶאָרַת הַתְּשׁוּבָה
through this the illumination of teshuvah flows
מִן רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה עַד יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים.
from Rosh Hashanah until Yom Kippur.
הַיְינוּ שֶׁעַל יְדֵי קְדוּשַּׁת "זָכוֹר" שֶׁל שַׁבָּת
that is, through the holiness of the "Remember" of Shabbos
onto the six weekdays before it,
there flows from the illumination of the holiness of Shabbos
onto the six weekdays after it.
